name: The Scuba Guy Barbados
summary: A small PADI dive operation on Brownes Beach in Carlisle Bay, run by owner and lead instructor Rajiv Grant. It teaches PADI courses from a first try-dive through to Dive Master, with dives in Carlisle Bay Marine Park and its six shallow shipwrecks. Groups are kept small.
standouts: Owner and lead instructor Rajiv Grant is a PADI Master Scuba Diver Trainer with over 15 years of diving experience
PADI courses from Discover Scuba Diving to Dive Master

trips.title: PADI Discover Scuba Diving
trips.summary: A half-day introduction to scuba for people with no experience. Instructors teach the basic skills in a safe setting before guests dive among fish and wrecks. All gear is provided.
trips.checkNotes: Prices do not include the online portions of the courses (stated on the courses page). Booking by contact form, email, phone or WhatsApp; no online booking. Course page photos are Unsplash stock, so no trip images recorded.

trips.title: PADI Open Water Course
trips.summary: The PADI entry-level certification, with pool skills practice and open water dives. On completion divers are certified to dive to 18 metres (60 feet) anywhere in the world. All gear is included.
highlights: Pool skills and open water dives
trips.checkNotes: Prices do not include the online portions of the courses (stated on the courses page). Booking by contact form, email, phone or WhatsApp; no online booking. Course page photos are Unsplash stock, so no trip images recorded.

trips.title: PADI Advance Open Water Course
trips.summary: A next-step PADI course built from adventure dives such as wreck, night, navigation or buoyancy dives. It certifies divers to 30 metres (100 feet). All gear is included.
highlights: Choose adventure dives such as wreck, night or peak performance buoyancy

trips.title: PADI Rescue Diver Course
trips.summary: A PADI course on preventing and handling problems in the water, from managing stress to emergency scenarios and rescue techniques. All gear is included.
highlights: Recognising and managing stress in yourself and others
trips.checkNotes: Prices do not include the online portions of the courses (stated on the courses page). Booking by contact form, email, phone or WhatsApp; no online booking. Course page photos are Unsplash stock, so no trip images recorded.

trips.summary: PADI specialty courses such as underwater photography, wreck diving, night diving and Enriched Air Diver. Prices depend on the specialty. All gear is included.

checkNotes: The site lists PADI courses only; it does not price or describe fun dives for certified divers, though the home page talks about guided dives in Carlisle Bay Marine Park. Two emails: rajiv@scubaguybarbados.com in the footer and admin@scubaguybarbados.com on the contact page (used here). Hours Monday to Saturday, 8:30am to 4pm. Pages were last updated between May 2024 and March 2025 (sitemap dates) and the About page still has template placeholders ('[Your Location]', '[Your Dive Company Name]'); the batch lists the business as active, so it is built, but trading status is worth confirming.
